milestones.title: CI green on scaffold
milestones.notes: CI was failing on missing pnpm-lock.yaml, Rust steps without Cargo.toml, package.json name-format, mypy annotation, and prettier. All fixes committed (ef9cfe2). CI run 24002619986 in progress.

milestones.title: Scaffold consistency hardening
milestones.notes: Aligned local verify behavior with scaffold mode, updated ADR lint to read docs/architecture/decisions, gated publish workflows when SDK folders are absent, and replaced critical template placeholders in policy/state/agent docs.

milestones.title: Codex customization parity
milestones.notes: Replaced Claude-specific docs/config references with Codex equivalents, renamed CLAUDE.md to CODEX.md, migrated settings to .codex-config, preserved all verification and hook constraints, and completed a follow-up audit that corrected README verification-count drift.
